title: Hausdorff integral over the range of a linear map with constant Jacobian
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, T : ℝ^n → ℝ^P continuous linear and j ≥ 0 with H^n(T(S)) = ofReal(j)·λ(S) for every S ⊆ ℝ^n (H^n = μHE[n] on ℝ^P, λ = Lebesgue measure on ℝ^n). Then for every continuous f : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫_{range T} f dH^n = j·∫_{ℝ^n} f(Tc) dλ(c).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (T : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (j : ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), 0 ≤ j → (∀ S : Set (Euclid n), μHE[n] (T '' S) = ENNReal.ofReal j * volume S) → Continuous f → ∫ y in (LinearMap.range (T : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) : Set (Euclid P)), f y ∂μHE[n] = j * ∫ c, f (T c) ∂volume
